title: A personal conclusion finds shared principles

captions.physics: Reflecting on examples and sharing conclusions
captions.emotions: Feeling confident in a shared convention

meaning: Your shared view can draw on an understandable principle when personal reflection reveals the substance of a familiar rule.
text: A familiar rule sometimes becomes genuinely understandable after personal reflection. The Hermit in the physical position of Ajna suggests considering an example and sharing a conclusion. The Hierophant in energy supports wanting to understand the principle behind an established form. The Hierophant in emotions feels confidence in a shared convention. His first role concerns interest in a rule’s substance; his second concerns experiencing understandable support. You may enjoy familiar words finally explaining particular experience and being accessible to both without simply having to accept them on trust.

For example, you examine captions beneath photographs in an old album. A repeated order of information initially seems arbitrary. After considering several examples, one person notices how it distinguishes place, time and the episode itself. **A shared principle offers support through an understandable personal conclusion.** The rule now feels substantial. You can explain each caption element’s purpose to one another. Confidence grows from understanding, while the familiar form still leaves space for photographs with some information missing.

The risk is declaring this form the only correct one for every kind of note once confidence arrives. A particular principle then loses contact with the task that made it useful. Wanting to understand the rule preserves a boundary: a shared convention supports your view when its role in arranging particular material remains visible.
